Tenets

How does a home make it to the Sobha Privy Collection? We set our own benchmarks to make certain it was a rigorous process. We call them the Privy Collection Tenets, and each one defines a unique and unmistakable aspect that must be satisfied.

Expansive Spaces

We have pushed beyond conventional boundaries in more ways than one. A Privy home features grand palatial spaces where luxury and convenience converge with equal elegance and finesse. Even in the heart of the bustling city you require a private, expansive retreat. Whether perched on a soaring tower in the sky or within an oasis of greenery, each home redefines the notion of scale.

Iconic Addresses

There are some locations that are known by one and all, yet little is known about their inner private worlds. The world's most iconic addresses are chosen for homes that sit at the pinnacle of success. These residences inspire awe, and stand apart from the rest of the city.

Uncompromising Finesse

There are some locations that are known by one and all, yet little is known about their inner private worlds. The world's most iconic addresses are chosen for homes that sit at the pinnacle of success. These residences inspire awe, and stand apart from the rest of the city.

Every amenity is thoughtfully curated as an extension of your unique tastes. World-class amenities that go beyond just your needs have been fine-tuned to cater to a private and elevating experience, every day.

Exclusive Amenities

Exceptional service

Our single-minded focus is to make sure every moment spent at a Privy residence is handled with personal care and warmth. We pride ourselves on personalised services that anticipate your every wish, to ensure an extraordinary life.

Extraordinary Privacy

We understand and value the discretion of our residents. We've ensured that every home comes with separate accessways, private floors and exclusive amenities. So, your world remains private.

A cut Above

Each jewel in this collection is a hallmark of rarity. Every address, every space and every experience have distinct aspects that set them apart.

Handpicked

and few enough to count
on one’s fingers

The process of making the Privy Collection began through exclusion: only a select number of properties can make the cut, the rarest jewels of all. Handpicked in every aspect, these residences are placed uniquely above and away from the rest.

Projects location

Projects location

  • Penthouses

    1 — 4

    Situated along the famed Sheikh Zayed Road atop one of Dubai’s most distinguished high-rise buildings, The S by Sobha Realty resides in proximity to the waterfront with majestic views of The Palm and Burj Al Arab. Guests can take advantage of the city’s most enticing offerings, from exclusive shopping and waterfront restaurants to world-class nightlife and entertainment.

  • Penthouses

    2 — 4

    Sobha Seahaven is a premier sea-facing destination perfectly positioned at the heart of the city’s prestigious Dubai Harbour. With unmatched views of Ain Dubai, Palm Jumeirah, and the Marina skyline, these elevated residences offer direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road and ease of access to both of Dubai’s international airports.

  • mansions, villas, 
    penthouses

    3 — 4

    Positioned in the private Sobha Hartland II community, moments from downtown Dubai, villas in Sobha Hartland II Estates, mansions, and iconic The S penthouses combine access to sophisticated restaurants and retail with waterfront living and spectacular views of Dubai Canal, downtown Dubai, Meydan Racecourse, and Ras Al Khor wildlife sanctuary.

  • Villas

    4 — 4

    Surrounded by the crystalline water and white sand beaches of Sobha Siniya Island, these beachside residences are set within a pristine natural paradise that embodies the ultimate in secluded luxury. Experience privacy, leisure and connection to nature with easy access to Dubai’s cosmopolitan offerings.

Mr. Ravi Menon
Chairman Sobha Realty

Mr. Ravi Menon
Chairman Sobha Realty

At Sobha Realty, the endeavour has always been to constantly raise the standard. Whether it is our craftsmanship, extreme detailing, or specialised service. Now we raise the standard of luxury living itself, with the launch of the Sobha Privy Collection.

In today's world where the term luxury is used lightly, we aim to redefine this space with a rare luxury collection of handpicked residences. Each of these specially selected residences is the result of our desire to create a portfolio of the rarest and most special spaces.

Every residence is meticulously crafted to reflect grandeur beyond the ordinary. With expert craftsmanship and a seamless blend of form, function, and beauty, the sublime is not just a concept, but a reality you can now experience every day.
